description: Search in-stock products on Ucun Select (home-textile wholesale platform, Nantong China). Supports Chinese or English keyword, category, material, and max-price filters; returns up to 50 matches sorted by relevance, default limit 10. Public read-only, no auth required. Returns an empty array (not an error) when nothing matches. Use this to discover products; then call get_stock with a returned id for full details, or list_categories for an inventory overview.

category.description: 品类：四件套/被子/被套/床单/枕套/面料/床盖等

keyword.description: 搜索词，如：四件套/被子/面料/棉/法兰绒/bedding/fabric

material.description: 材质：全棉/聚酯纤维/法兰绒/磨毛等
